findings.finding: serializeTable renders a cell only when textContent.trim() is non-empty; an image-only cell (| ![x](a.png) |) or hard-break-only cell is written empty, silently dropping the image.
findings.suggestion: Test content.childCount > 0 instead; add round-trip case with an image in a cell.

findings.finding: isGfmRepresentable ignores a hardBreak inside a cell paragraph (renderInline emits a newline that splits the row) and a non-paragraph single child (list).
findings.suggestion: Require firstChild paragraph and no hardBreak descendants, else HTML fallback; add tests.

findings.finding: Pipe escaping uses a negative lookbehind for a single backslash; when the text already holds a literal backslash before a pipe (escaped as two backslashes) the pipe stays unescaped and the cell splits.
findings.suggestion: Escape when the preceding backslash run length is even; add a test with a backslash before a pipe.

findings.finding: Image.configure({allowBase64:false}) makes TipTap's parseHTML drop img[src^=data:], so a data: URI image vanishes on save.
findings.suggestion: Set allowBase64 true; add a test.

findings.finding: Image src not validated; opening a file fetches any remote image (tracking beacon), inconsistent with the link allowlist.
findings.suggestion: Document the decision or add an image-src allowlist.

findings.finding: lib imports from components (MermaidCodeBlockView) while components import back from lib: reversed dependency direction.
findings.suggestion: Inject the node view as a parameter or move the nodes file next to the components.

findings.finding: Debounce timer + setState run for every code block on every keystroke, not only mermaid.
findings.suggestion: Only mount the debounce in a child component for mermaid blocks.

findings.finding: state.inTable never reset if renderInline throws; loose task list silently rewritten tight without a test.
findings.suggestion: try/finally; add a test documenting loose->tight.

findings.finding: setColumnAlign position math is correct; column lookup by index is wrong for colspan/rowspan tables (HTML fallback).
findings.suggestion: Optional: disable align buttons for non-GFM tables.

findings.finding: Coverage gaps: image-only cell, hardBreak in cell, backslash before pipe, data: image, loose task list, debounce proof.
Claim under doubt: Images and tables round-trip losslessly — Image.configure allowBase64:false drops a data: URI image on load; no lossy warning.
findings.suggestion: allowBase64 true plus a data-URI round-trip test.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: A GFM table cell serializes everything it contains — serializeTable writes a cell only when textContent.trim() is non-empty; an image-only or hard-break-only cell is emptied.
findings.suggestion: Use childCount for emptiness; test image-only and badge-link cells.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Pipes in table cells are always escaped correctly — The lookbehind skips a pipe preceded by a backslash, but a literal backslash is itself escaped to two backslashes so the pipe stays bare and splits the cell.
findings.suggestion: Escape every pipe in cell output unconditionally; add tests for a backslash next to a pipe and a pipe in a code span.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Forcing tight lists for task lists is harmless — Tight forcing may collapse multi-paragraph task items; a mixed task/plain list may drop or rewrite an item.
findings.suggestion: Round-trip tests for multi-paragraph item, nested bullet, code block in item, loose list, mixed list.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Non-GFM tables fall back to lossless HTML — outerHTML is written with raw newlines: inside a list/quote later lines lose the container prefix, and a blank line ends the HTML block early.
findings.suggestion: Collapse newlines to character references; tests for table in list/quote and code block in a cell.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: Inline images serialize as valid Markdown — A src with a space is written unwrapped and is invalid on re-read; markdown-it percent-encodes destinations.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the destination in angle brackets when it has whitespace or parens; document percent-encoding.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: A code block round-trips and the info string is safe — Only the first word of the info string survives; a tilde fence with a backtick in the language becomes an invalid backtick fence.
findings.suggestion: Lossy-warning rule for extra info-string words; tilde fence when the language contains a backtick.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The mermaid preview is isolated and leak-free — No script path found; render id collides for identical blocks mounted in the same millisecond; orphan error svgs; eager rendering of many diagrams.
findings.suggestion: Unique render id; lazy rendering optional.

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: CRLF, size and mixed-EOL are handled — state.inTable is not reset when renderInline throws.
